summary: ZTO Express filed a 6-K attaching five Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns reporting ongoing open-market repurchases of American depositary shares, each representing one Class A ordinary share, under its share buyback program. Disclosed repurchases include 73,128 ADSs at USD22.98 on August 12, 218,268 at USD22.89 on August 13, 218,091 at USD22.91 on August 14, 218,381 at USD22.88 on August 17, and numerous follow-on transactions through August 21 priced between USD21.22 and USD23.00. The ADSs were bought but not yet cancelled, leaving issued-share capital unchanged. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal terms are stated; these are routine daily repurchase disclosures. Watch cancelled-versus-treasury treatment and pace of future buybacks.
